The 1,629-byte handoff is the actual generated pin/clock data from the retained
2026-11-04 ZX81 HPS-first build (`out/nano-tenfoot-serial-20261104/core-zx81`).
It exercises the existing strict HPS pin parser and USB compiled-policy emitter.
It is a data fixture, not a complete sealed project, boot image or qualification
of a board's PHY/VBUS. Test identities and the small build receipt are synthetic.
